about: Every tracked Python file with its fate and the phase of the move to 100% CeTTa that retires it. tests/unit/python_reference.metta fails on an unlisted .py file or an entry whose file is gone, so the list only shrinks; when it is empty, no Python remains. The old code stays reachable at reference_tag. A module outlives every module that imports or runs it; a test goes with the earliest module it covers. Before a file goes, its algorithms and its ergonomic and aesthetic features are each found natively or ported first.

fates.port-test: a test whose claims become a native test
fates.delete-with-native-coverage: leaves once native tests cover every behaviour it checks or provides
fates.port-tool: an operator, mode or demonstration tool rewritten in MeTTa
fates.dead: nothing runs it and its features are met natively
fates.vendored-external: third-party code; upstream stays an outside reference at a pinned commit
